newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korean defector explains his flight.
newsitem.headline: North Korean defector explains his flight.

text.p: The following are excerpts from a prepared text read by North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop after arriving in South Korea on Sunday.
Hwang, the most senior Pyongyang offical to betray his communist homeland, defected to the South Korean consulate in Beijing on February 12 and had been in the Philippines since March 18.
-- There is no way for people (in North Korea) in their right minds to express themselves. Rather, they have reached the point where they cannot properly breathe amid controls and supervision.

-- North Korea has changed into an abnormal system, a mix of socialism, modern feudalism and militarism. Its economy is entering a state of overall paralysis. People are groaning with starvation and North Korean authorities finally have been forced to thrust out their hands for salvation to the international community.
-- A country which boasts it has built a heaven on earth has turned into a nation begging for a living.
-- North Korea seems to think there is no option but to use the powerful military force it has built up over decades.
-- North Korea denounces reform and opening as an unsocialist path. It is only seeking confrontation of military power while rejecting dialogue with South Korea.

-- Confrontation between North and South today is not a confrontation between socialism and capitalism. It is a confrontation between feudal dictatorship and free democracy, a confrontation between feudal militarism and a capitalistic economy, a confrontation between war and peace.
-- I could not disobey the order of my conscience: all those I love put together cannot be traded for the life-and-death fate of the 70 million people of our race.
-- I came to South Korea because I am convinced the only way out is to block war by joining hands with our brothers in the South.

-- I take this opportunity to sincerely urge the North Korean authorities to abandon their revolutionary line towards South Korea and take the path of reform and opening to liberate naked and starving citizens from famine.

-- If my compatriots in the South permit, I only hope to show repentance to some degree before my race by joining forces to block war provocations and devoting my remaining energies to peaceful reunification.
